body.command:
cd ~/dotpals-video/out/reel-jev-review && python - <<'EOF'
from PIL import Image
names = ['jev-3.8s','jev-7.5s','jev-12.5s','jev-15.6s','jev-18.0s','jev-19.8s','jev-22.0s','jev-27.5s','jev-31.8s','jev-35.0s','jev-42.4s','jev-47.6s']
w, h = 360, 640
for k in range(2):
    sheet = Image.new('RGB', (w*6, h), 'white')
    for i, n in enumerate(names[k*6:(k+1)*6]):
        sheet.paste(Image.open(n + '.png').resize((w, h)), (i*w, 0))
    sheet.save(f'sheet-{k}.png')
print('ok')
EOF
